name: DIDWW Public API
description:
JSONAPI interface to the DIDWW platform: browse coverage, order and manage DIDs,
route them to voice trunks, and reserve numbers before purchase.

Every request must include an API key in the `Api-Key` header. See
[Authentication for API v2026-04-16](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-04-16/authentication.html)
for instructions on creating an API key and including it in requests.

Versions are selected per request with the `X-DIDWW-Api-Version` header,
defaulting to the
version configured for the API key's customer; this document describes
`2026-04-16`.

Released dated DIDWW API v3 versions remain available and maintained, they
are not sunset and have no version-retirement deadline. New features and
breaking changes are introduced in new dated versions rather than changing
a previously released version. Deprecated fields are documented in the
version-specific schemas and changelogs, deprecation does not itself set a
removal date. See the
[API Versioning and Deprecation Policy](https://doc.didww.com/api3/api-versioning.html)
for version support, deprecated fields, and migration guidance. This policy
applies to REST API v3, not the separate OTP Verification API.

Response schemas describe the full resource. A request narrowing one with
`fields[...]` receives fewer members than its schema lists, deliberately:
OpenAPI cannot express a member that is required only until a query
parameter prunes it.
